per_query_scifact.source: User follow-up read-only aggregation of all six existing profile reports; 180 samples per query. These are phase medians, not raw timestamp records.
per_query_scifact.assessment: At4096, A query8 has4399 positive candidates and is the only remaining dense path; its score and TopK phases are each the largest A phase. This supports the batch-tail explanation for unchanged A Search. B has no dense query at4096. At2048 B still has dense queries1/6/7 despite a much lower pooled task median.
